topology: Milan head and Tinkara HDB and load. Local NVMe WAL and DuckDB. NFSv4 Parquet handoff. Two synchronous native subscribers.
setup_check: All selected binaries matched SHA-256 on all three pods. An initial control pair was discarded after its HDB executable failed the transfer checksum. Both full control minutes were rerun with fresh storage.
counter_method: First and last sample within the ingest window. NIC counters include other host traffic.
